senses.example: He comprado patatas para la tortilla.
senses.exampleGloss: I have bought potatoes for the omelette.

alternatives.reason: LatAm form for the vegetable; in Spain papa is the Pope, so it is never taught here.
The Peninsular word for sweet potato; a real near-miss to keep separate.
In colloquial Spain patata can also mean a clumsy mistake; leave that sense out of A2.

notes: patata is the standard Peninsular form; tortilla de patatas is the canonical Navarre household dish.
